Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: Brad Wilcox
Message:
feat: add namecheap-dns guard-railed DNS CLI (#33)

Namecheap's setHosts replaces the ENTIRE record set and silently drops
custom MX records without EmailType=MX — one bare call can take down
business email and every subdomain. This tool makes the safe pattern
the only pattern: every mutation backs up to JSON, re-submits the full
set, and diff-verifies the result, dying loudly with a restore command
on any drift.

Self-tested live against automationarchitecture.ai (add + delete of a
TXT probe record; all 21 production records preserved through both
writes).
